en: someone preparing to take a state exam

examples.ko: 제 동생은 공무원 시험을 준비하는 고시생이에요.
examples.en: My younger sibling is an exam candidate preparing for the civil service test.
Exam candidates study at the library until late at night.

examples.ko: 이 동네에는 고시생을 위한 작은 방이 많아요.
examples.en: This neighborhood has many small rooms for exam candidates.

examples.ko: 고시생 때는 친구를 거의 못 만났어요.
examples.en: When I was an exam candidate, I hardly met friends.

examples.ko: 이 식당은 고시생에게 밥값을 깎아 줘요.
examples.en: This restaurant gives exam candidates a discount.

examples.ko: 오랜 시간 고시생으로 지내서 많이 지쳤어요.
examples.en: I spent a long time as an exam candidate and got very worn out.

explain: 나라에서 보는 큰 시험을 준비하는 사람을 말해요. 요즘은 공무원 시험을 준비하는 사람을 '공시생'이라고도 해요.

phrases.example: 저는 지금 공시생이라 매일 도서관에 가요.
phrases.en: I'm a civil service exam student now, so I go to the library every day.
phrases.nuance_ko: 공무원 시험을 준비하는 사람을 줄여 부르는 말이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: A short name for someone preparing for the civil service exam.

phrases.example: 고시생 시절에는 친구를 거의 못 만났어요.
phrases.en: During my exam-prep days, I hardly met friends.
phrases.nuance_ko: 시험을 준비하던 때를 돌아보며 말할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used when looking back on the time of exam preparation.

phrases.en: I decided to become an exam student after graduating.
phrases.nuance_ko: 시험 준비를 시작하는 결정을 말할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used when deciding to start exam preparation.

explain_en: It refers to a person preparing for a major state-run exam. These days, someone preparing for the civil service exam is also called a '공시생'.

examples.ko: 이 책은 한국어 공부의 좋은 길잡이가 돼요.
examples.en: This book is a good guide for studying Korean.
Stars were the guide for sailors in the old days.
The map served as a guide for the trip.

examples.ko: 선생님은 제게 인생의 길잡이 같은 분이에요.
examples.en: My teacher is like a guiding light in my life.
Using the signs as a guide, I walked along the forest path.
I made a guide video for beginners.

explain: 책 제목에 '~ 길잡이'가 많아서 '입문서'처럼 쓰여요. 길을 안내하는 사람은 '안내자'나 '가이드'라고 해요. 비유로 '인생의 길잡이'라고 하면 좋은 선생님이나 조언을 가리켜요.

phrases.example: 이 책이 제게 좋은 길잡이가 됐어요.
phrases.en: This book became a good guide for me.
phrases.nuance_ko: 책, 사람, 경험이 방향을 알려 줄 때 '되다'와 함께 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used with 되다 when a book, person or experience gives direction.

phrases.en: My parents are my guide in life.
phrases.nuance_ko: 삶의 방향을 알려 주는 사람이나 말을 비유로 말해요.
phrases.nuance_en: A figurative phrase for someone or something that guides your life.

phrases.example: 이 여행 길잡이를 보고 계획을 짰어요.
phrases.en: I made my plan using this travel guide.
phrases.nuance_ko: 앞에 분야를 붙여 처음 하는 사람을 위한 안내 책을 말해요.
phrases.nuance_en: Put a topic before it to mean a beginner's guidebook on that topic.

explain_en: Book titles often end in '~ 길잡이', where it works like '입문서' (an intro guide). A person who leads the way is a '안내자' or '가이드'. As a metaphor, '인생의 길잡이' means a good teacher or piece of advice.

examples.en: A triangle has three vertices.
Connect the vertices of the square with lines.

examples.ko: 이 도형의 꼭짓점은 모두 몇 개예요?
examples.en: How many vertices does this shape have in total?

examples.ko: 꼭짓점에 A, B, C라고 이름을 붙였어요.
examples.en: I labeled the vertices A, B and C.
I counted the number of vertices of the solid shape.
Fold the paper and line up the corners with each other.

explain: 수학 시간에 도형의 선(변)이 만나는 점을 말할 때 써요. 도형 이야기에서는 '변'과 짝으로 같이 나오고, 일상 대화에서는 거의 안 쓰고 수업이나 교과서에서 많이 들려요.

phrases.en: If you connect the three vertices, it becomes a triangle.
phrases.nuance_ko: 도형을 그릴 때 점을 선으로 연결한다는 뜻으로 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used when drawing shapes, meaning to connect points with lines.

phrases.en: A rectangle has four vertices.
phrases.nuance_ko: 도형의 꼭짓점 수를 말할 때 숫자와 함께 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used with a number to say how many vertices a shape has.

phrases.en: Mark each vertex by putting a dot on it.
phrases.nuance_ko: 수학 문제에서 꼭짓점의 위치를 표시하라고 할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used in math problems when asked to mark the position of a vertex.
phrases.en_equiv: to mark a vertex with a dot

explain_en: It is used in math class for the point where the lines (변) of a shape meet, and it often appears together with '변'. It is rare in daily conversation and mostly heard in lessons and textbooks.

examples.en: The new president announced the cabinet.

examples.ko: 내각이 바뀌면 정책도 달라질 수 있어요.
examples.en: When the cabinet changes, policies can change too.

examples.ko: 신문에 내각 개편 기사가 크게 났어요.
examples.en: A big article on the cabinet reshuffle appeared in the newspaper.
If you add up all the interior angles of a triangle, you get 180 degrees.

examples.ko: 그 장관은 내각에서 가장 젊은 사람이에요.
examples.en: That minister is the youngest person in the cabinet.
All the ministers of the cabinet attended the meeting.

explain: 총리와 장관들이 모인 정부의 중심 모임을 말해요. 뉴스에서는 '내각 개편', '내각 구성'처럼 자주 나와요. 수학 시간에는 도형 안쪽 각을 가리키는 '내각'도 써요. 반대말은 '외각'이에요.

phrases.example: 다음 달에 내각 개편이 있을 거예요.
phrases.en: There will be a cabinet reshuffle next month.
phrases.nuance_ko: 장관들을 바꾸는 일을 말해요. 뉴스에서 아주 자주 나와요.
phrases.nuance_en: Refers to changing the ministers. Very common in the news.

phrases.en: The cabinet meeting is held this morning.
phrases.nuance_ko: 총리와 장관들이 모여 이야기하는 회의예요. '열리다'와 같이 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: A meeting where the prime minister and ministers gather. Used with 열리다.

phrases.en: The sum of the interior angles of a triangle is 180 degrees.
phrases.nuance_ko: 수학에서 도형 안쪽 각을 말할 때 써요. 정부 뜻과는 전혀 달라요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used in math for the angles inside a shape. Completely different from the government meaning.

explain_en: It means the group of the prime minister and ministers at the center of a government. The news uses it in phrases like '내각 개편' (cabinet reshuffle) and '내각 구성'. In math class, 내각 is also the angle inside a shape, and its opposite is 외각.

examples.en: I majored in biology at university.
Today in biology class we learned about cells.
Reading a biology book makes me curious about the body.
My younger sibling wants to become a biologist.
The biology exam is tomorrow, so I'm studying all night.

examples.ko: 최근 생물학 연구에서 새로운 발견이 나왔어요.
examples.en: A new discovery came out of recent biology research.

explain: 생물학은 살아 있는 것을 연구하는 학문이에요. 대학교에서는 '생물학과'에서 배워요. 이 분야의 사람은 '생물학자'라고 해요.

phrases.en: My younger sibling is in the biology department at university.
phrases.nuance_ko: 대학교에서 생물학을 배우는 학과를 말해요.
phrases.nuance_en: The university department where biology is studied.

phrases.en: I want to become a biologist when I grow up.
phrases.nuance_ko: 생물학을 연구하는 사람을 말해요.
phrases.nuance_en: A person who studies biology.

phrases.en: I have a biology exam tomorrow.
phrases.nuance_ko: 과목 이름 뒤에 다른 명사를 붙여 쓸 수 있어요.
phrases.nuance_en: You can attach other nouns after the subject name.

explain_en: 생물학 is the science that studies living things. At university it is studied in a '생물학과' (biology department). A person in this field is a '생물학자'.

examples.ko: 이 사전은 오만 개의 단어를 수록해요.
examples.en: This dictionary includes fifty thousand words.
We included ten songs on the new album.

examples.ko: 이 잡지는 신인 작가의 시를 수록한 특별호를 냈어요.
examples.en: This magazine put out a special issue that includes poems by new writers.

examples.ko: 작가는 이 책에 여행기를 수록하려고 해요.
examples.en: The author is trying to include travel essays in this book.
If you include many photos, the book price goes up.
The editor decided to include the full interview.

explain: 책·사전·앨범·잡지 같은 곳에 글이나 곡을 실을 때 써요. 일상 대화에서는 '들어 있다', '실려 있다'가 더 자연스럽고 '수록하다'는 소개글이나 설명에 많이 나와요. 안에 실린 쪽은 '수록되다'예요.

phrases.en: That song is included on the new album.
phrases.nuance_ko: 글이나 곡이 책이나 앨범에 실린 쪽에서 쓰는 피동형이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: The passive form, from the point of view of what is included.

phrases.en: This story is printed in the textbook.
phrases.nuance_ko: 일상 대화에서는 '수록하다'보다 더 자연스러워요.
phrases.nuance_en: More natural than 수록하다 in everyday conversation.

phrases.example: 수록곡 중에서 세 번째 곡이 제일 좋아요.
phrases.en: Of the tracks on the album, the third is my favorite.
phrases.nuance_ko: 앨범에 들어 있는 곡을 가리키는 짝말이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: A common word for the songs included on an album.

explain_en: Used when putting writing or songs into a book, dictionary, album or magazine. In daily talk '들어 있다' or '실려 있다' is more natural; 수록하다 appears in blurbs and descriptions. The passive is 수록되다.

dis.h: include in a book or collection

examples.ko: 그 회사는 신기술 개발에 많이 투자해요.
examples.en: That company invests a lot in developing new technology.
Thanks to new technology, the battery lasts long.
New technology has been applied to the new phone.
I take online lectures to learn new technology.
New technology is also widely used in agriculture.
Do you want to go to the new technology briefing together?

explain: '신기술 개발', '신기술 적용', '신기술 도입'처럼 뉴스나 회사 소개에서 자주 나와요. '최신 기술'은 지금 가장 새로운 기술이라는 느낌이 강하고, '신기술'은 새로 만들어진 기술 자체를 말해요.

phrases.example: 회사가 신기술 개발에 힘을 쏟고 있어요.
phrases.en: The company is putting effort into new technology development.
phrases.nuance_ko: 뉴스나 회사 소개에서 가장 자주 보이는 짝말이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: The pairing most often seen in news and company profiles.

phrases.en: The factory needs to adopt new technology.
phrases.nuance_ko: 이미 있는 기술을 가져와 쓰기 시작한다는 뜻이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: Means starting to use a technology that already exists elsewhere.

phrases.example: 이 제품은 신기술을 적용해서 소리가 작아졌어요.
phrases.en: This product applies new technology, so it became quieter.
phrases.nuance_ko: 제품이나 서비스에 기술을 실제로 쓴다는 뜻이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: Means the technology is actually used in a product or service.

explain_en: It shows up in news and company profiles in phrases like '신기술 개발', '신기술 적용' and '신기술 도입'. '최신 기술' stresses the very latest, while '신기술' refers to newly created technology itself.

examples.en: We learned rational and irrational numbers in math class.

examples.ko: 분수로 나타낼 수 있는 수는 유리수예요.
examples.en: A number that can be written as a fraction is a rational number.
All integers are included among the rational numbers.
The answer to this problem is not a rational number.
Adding rational numbers is the same as calculating with fractions.

examples.ko: 선생님이 칠판에 유리수를 몇 개 적으셨어요.
examples.en: The teacher wrote a few rational numbers on the board.

explain: 수학 시간에 나오는 말로, 짝이 되는 말은 '무리수'예요. '유리수'와 '무리수'를 함께 묻는 문제가 많아요. 일상 대화에서는 거의 안 쓰고 수업과 교재에서 만나요.

phrases.en: Explain the difference between rational and irrational numbers.
phrases.nuance_ko: 짝이 되는 말과 함께 자주 나와요.
phrases.nuance_en: Often appears together with its paired term.

phrases.en: One half is a rational number.
phrases.nuance_ko: 어떤 수가 유리수라고 말할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used to state that a number is rational.

phrases.en: Find out whether this number is rational or not.
phrases.nuance_ko: 수학 문제에서 자주 보는 질문 형태예요.
phrases.nuance_en: A common question form in math problems.
phrases.en_equiv: whether it is rational or not

explain_en: This is a math-class word, and its counterpart is '무리수' (irrational number). Questions often ask about both together. It is rarely used in daily talk and mostly appears in lessons and textbooks.

examples.en: A beehive is shaped like hexagons.
Try drawing a hexagon on the paper.
A hexagon has six angles in all.
Most snow crystals are shaped like hexagons.
This pencil is hexagonal, so it is comfortable to hold.
A soccer ball has many hexagon patterns.

explain: 변이 여섯 개인 도형으로, 수학 시간에 '삼각형, 사각형, 오각형' 다음에 나와요. 자연에서는 벌집이나 눈 결정에서 많이 볼 수 있어요. 한자어 숫자로 '육'을 쓴다는 점이 '오각형, 칠각형'과 같아요.

phrases.en: This chocolate box is hexagon-shaped.
phrases.nuance_ko: 물건의 모양을 말할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used to describe the shape of an object.

phrases.en: I cut the paper into a hexagon.
phrases.nuance_ko: 만들기나 수업 시간에 쓰는 말이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used in crafts or class.

phrases.en: A hexagon is a shape with six sides.
phrases.nuance_ko: 뜻을 쉽게 풀어서 설명하는 말이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: A simple explanation of the meaning.

explain_en: It is a shape with six sides, and in math class it follows '삼각형, 사각형, 오각형'. In nature you see it in beehives and snow crystals. It uses the Sino-Korean number '육', like '오각형' and '칠각형'.

en: to be studied; to be learned

examples.en: Language is learned by repeating it.
This AI was trained on a lot of data.
A habit learned by a child lasts a long time.
It takes time for good habits to be learned.
Movements learned by the body come out naturally.

examples.ko: 이 내용은 이미 학습돼서 문제를 풀 수 있어요.
examples.en: This content has already been learned, so I can solve the problem.

explain: '학습되다'는 배우는 사람이 아니라 '배워진 결과'를 보는 말이에요. 인공지능이 데이터로 배우는 상황에서 특히 자주 써요. 사람이 직접 배울 때는 '배우다', '공부하다'가 훨씬 자연스러워요.

phrases.en: I check the content that was learned again.
phrases.nuance_ko: 이미 배워서 알게 된 내용을 말할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used for content that has already been learned.

phrases.en: This model has been trained well on Korean.
phrases.nuance_ko: 배운 결과가 좋게 남았을 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used when the result of learning has stayed well.

phrases.example: 이 프로그램에는 많은 문장이 학습돼 있어요.
phrases.en: This program has learned many sentences.
phrases.nuance_ko: 이미 배워진 상태라는 뜻이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: Means it is already in a learned state.

explain_en: 학습되다 looks at the result of being learned rather than the learner. It is especially common for AI learning from data. When a person learns directly, 배우다 or 공부하다 sounds much more natural.
